About

Walter Works is a small studio run by Thomas Shear in the United States.

What we make

We make practical admin kits for solo service businesses: freelancers, consultants and small agencies. Each kit is a step-by-step workflow with editable templates, checklists and AI prompts for one recurring job, such as agreeing project scope with a client.

Our first kit is the Scope Guard & Client Onboarding Kit.

How the kits are made

Our kits are written with AI assistance. Before release, each one is checked against a written quality checklist. Any examples in a kit are fictional and labelled as such.

Our kits are not legal, tax or financial advice.
